title: Amazon-owned Bee unveils two personal AI devices
excerpt: Bee has released its first AI hardware under Amazon, introducing an updated wearable and a card-sized smartphone recorder starting at $75.
body_html:
Amazon-owned Bee has introduced its first new artificial intelligence devices following its acquisition. The hardware lineup features an updated wearable alongside a compact, credit-card-sized recording device designed to attach directly to smartphones.

The newly released gadgets are equipped to perform several productivity tasks, such as generating conversation summaries and compiling to-do lists. Additionally, the devices offer built-in integration with Alexa and Amazon shopping services.

Pricing for the new personal AI product line begins at $74.99.
